entities.name: Supplied herpesvirus UNG
observations: The 255-aa query sequence exactly matches UniProt P28275 from human herpesvirus 2 strain HG52.
The protein contains a Pfam UDG domain (PF03167.26) at positions 86–243.
Predicted molecular mass is 28.48 kDa and theoretical pI is 8.88.

entities.name: P28275
observations: Excises uracil from DNA arising from dUMP misincorporation or cytosine deamination.
Annotated to the host cell nucleus.

entities.name: Base-excision repair
observations: P28275 is annotated with GO:0006284, base-excision repair.

entities.name: Uracil-DNA glycosylase activity
observations: The enzyme hydrolyzes uracil-containing single-stranded DNA or mismatched double-stranded DNA to release free uracil; EC 3.2.2.27.
